summary: Gospel: 70–110 BPM, organ and piano, churchy I–IV with secondary dominants (II7–V7), big choir pads
body: Drums: a shuffling or straight pocket with fills between phrases; also 6/8 for ballads.
Harmony: I–IV with passing chords, II7 and VI7 secondary dominants, plagal (IV–I) cadences; organ swells.
Sounds: Hammond organ (drawbars), piano, a choir.
Builds: key changes up a step, call and response.

Apply: pattern/gmd-gospel-beat-1 on the drums, then pattern/prog-gospel-characteristic-1 on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 70–110 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
